Understanding your hair loss

If you have noticed a change in your hairline or crown, you may be wondering what it means and what to do next. A consultation gives your doctor the chance to review your hair loss history, examine your scalp and discuss your concerns before recommending care.

Your assessment, step by step

  1. 01

    Talk through your concerns

    Share when you first noticed changes, how they have developed and what you would like to understand about your hair.

  2. 02

    Review your hair & scalp

    Your doctor assesses your hairline, crown and scalp alongside your health history and current hair care routine.

  3. 03

    Discuss the options

    Talk through suitable care options, what each involves, expected commitments and any questions you have.

  4. 04

    Agree on your next steps

    Decide on a plan with your doctor and arrange the follow-up needed to review your progress.

Your care journey

  1. Your first visit

    Build a clear picture of your concerns and discuss an initial plan.

  2. Starting your plan

    Understand the routine, instructions and review schedule agreed with your doctor.

  3. Reviewing progress

    Discuss any changes, questions or difficulties during follow-up appointments.

  4. Ongoing care

    Revisit your goals and care plan with your doctor as your needs change.

Your doctor will explain the review schedule and expectations for your individual plan.
